_comment: The two tables `./kit money add-tables` adds to a client's schema.json. `./kit money load` fills them; a row already loaded (same Row Key / Finding Key) is skipped, so loading overlapping exports twice doesn't double anything.

tables.name: Money Transactions
tables.description: Every row from the business's bank, sales and supplier files, sorted into spending groups by ./kit money

fields.name: Row Key
fields.description: fingerprint of the row, so the same row is never loaded twice

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: money in is positive, money out is negative

fields.name: From File
fields.description: file and line it came from

tables.name: Money Findings
tables.description: What ./kit money found: where money is leaking, what it is worth, the fix and the first step

fields.name: Per Month
fields.description: what fixing it is worth every month

fields.name: One Time
fields.description: money to get back once (refunds, missing deposits, unpaid invoices, extra stock)

fields.name: Check First
fields.description: might be on purpose: look before acting
